title: 695. Implement Magic Dictionary

examples.explanation: Only hhllo differs by exactly one letter from a stored word of equal length.
hello matches hallo with one change and vice versa.

hints: A search succeeds when some stored word has equal length and differs in exactly one position.

Design adaptation: this task uses runMagicDictionary(operations, words) instead of a class; for buildDict, words[i] packs the whole dictionary with '|' separators, while for search it holds the single query.
Compare each query against stored words of the same length and count mismatches with early exit past one.
